messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The GO requests the measurements to the MSP. The MSP checks the received request. The MSP denies the request of the GO or the MSP performs the measurement. The MSP informs the GO about the failure of the reading or the MSP transmits the measured values to the GO. The GO processes the measured values. The GO sends the changed values to the MSP. The GO transmit the readings to the SP.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:omgdc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:omgdi="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  id="Definitions_1"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn">

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_GO" name="GO" processRef="Process_GO" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MSP" name="MSP" processRef="Process_MSP" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SP" name="SP" processRef="Process_SP" />

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequestMeasurements" sourceRef="Task_RequestMeasurements" targetRef="StartEvent_MSP" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DenyRequest" sourceRef="Task_DenyRequest" targetRef="CatchFailure_GO" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InformFailure" sourceRef="Task_InformFailure" targetRef="CatchFailure_GO" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TransmitMeasuredValues" sourceRef="Task_TransmitMeasuredValues" targetRef="CatchMeasuredValues_GO" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SendChangedValues" sourceRef="Task_SendChangedValues" targetRef="CatchChangedValues_MSP" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TransmitReadings" sourceRef="Task_TransmitReadingsToSP" targetRef="CatchReadings_SP" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- ==================== GO PROCESS ==================== -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_GO" name="GO" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GO" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestMeasurements" name="Request measurements to MSP">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_EventBased_GO" name="Wait for MSP response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchFailure_GO" name="Receive failure notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_Failure" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchMeasuredValues_GO" name="Receive measured values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_MeasuredValues" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Failure_GO" name="Process ended due to failure">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessMeasuredValues" name="Process measured values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendChangedValues" name="Send changed values to MSP">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransmitReadingsToSP" name="Transmit readings to SP">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GO_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_GO" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GO_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_GO" targetRef="Task_RequestMeasurements" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GO_2" sourceRef="Task_RequestMeasurements" targetRef="Gateway_EventBased_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GO_3" sourceRef="Gateway_EventBased_GO" targetRef="CatchFailure_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GO_4" sourceRef="Gateway_EventBased_GO" targetRef="CatchMeasuredValues_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GO_5" sourceRef="CatchFailure_GO" targetRef="EndEvent_Failure_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GO_6" sourceRef="CatchMeasuredValues_GO" targetRef="Task_ProcessMeasuredValues" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GO_7" sourceRef="Task_ProcessMeasuredValues" targetRef="Task_SendChangedValues" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GO_8" sourceRef="Task_SendChangedValues" targetRef="Task_TransmitReadingsToSP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GO_9" sourceRef="Task_TransmitReadingsToSP" targetRef="EndEvent_GO" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- ==================== MSP PROCESS ==================== -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSP" name="MSP" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MSP" name="Receive request from GO">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_Request" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check received request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckResult" name="Request valid?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyRequest" name="Deny request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Denied_MSP" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PerformMeasurement" name="Perform the measurement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MeasurementResult" name="Measurement successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformFailure" name="Inform GO about failure of reading">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FailureInformed_MSP" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransmitMeasuredValues" name="Transmit measured values to GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchChangedValues_MSP" name="Receive changed values from GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSP_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_ChangedValues" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MSP" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSP_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MSP" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_CheckResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_3" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckResult" targetRef="Task_DenyRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_4" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckResult" targetRef="Task_PerformMeasurement" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_5" sourceRef="Task_DenyRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_Denied_MSP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_6" sourceRef="Task_PerformMeasurement" targetRef="Gateway_MeasurementResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_7" name="Failure" sourceRef="Gateway_MeasurementResult" targetRef="Task_InformFailure" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_8" name="Success" sourceRef="Gateway_MeasurementResult" targetRef="Task_TransmitMeasuredValues" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_9" sourceRef="Task_InformFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_FailureInformed_MSP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_10" sourceRef="Task_TransmitMeasuredValues" targetRef="CatchChangedValues_MSP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSP_11" sourceRef="CatchChangedValues_MSP" targetRef="EndEvent_MSP" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- ==================== SP PROCESS ==================== -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SP" name="SP" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchReadings_SP" name="Receive readings from GO">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SP_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_Readings" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SP" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SP_1</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP_1" sourceRef="CatchReadings_SP" targetRef="EndEvent_SP" />
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
